name: Trading OS v3 — Market Watch
flow: Every 30 Minutes (scheduleTrigger, minutesInterval 30) -> Market Hours Gate (code: production runs pass only Mon-Fri 13:30-20:00 UTC; manual runs pass as dry_run=true) -> Get Open Positions (dataTable get positions_state {{TABLE_POSITIONS_STATE_ID}}, status eq OPEN, returnAll) -> Build Symbol Query (code, executeOnce: join symbols) -> Fetch Prices (httpRequest GET https://api.twelvedata.com/price?symbol=..., genericCredentialType httpQueryAuth, retryOnFail, 5 credits/run) -> Evaluate Positions (code) -> [branch A] Skip Writes On Dry Run (filter dry_run=false) -> Update Position Row (dataTable update by symbol: last_price, high_20d, pending_action, pending_since, last_stop_alert, last_tp_alert, last_updated); [branch B] Collect Alerts (code, executeOnce) -> Send Market Alerts (telegram sendMessage chat {{TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID}}, HTML, credential {{CREDENTIAL_ID}})
evaluate_logic: per OPEN position with a fetched price: newHigh = max(high_20d, price). (a) price <= hard_stop*1.02 -> near-stop alert once/day (last_stop_alert). (b) if !manual_override: formula = round2(newHigh*(1-trail_pct/100)); if formula > hard_stop*1.01 and pending_action != 'raise stop to X' -> RAISE STOP alert (with earnings note if next_earnings within 5 days) + write pending_action/pending_since; no re-alert while identical pending exists. (c) price >= tp_order -> TP alert once/day (last_tp_alert). Alerts joined into one Telegram message; dry runs write nothing.
